title: Next Fest is coming up: Squarelings
author: Cinicola
selftext:
Our game Squarelings will be at Steam Next Fest. 

We have been using Codex for the last 6 months. Our workflow has been to come up with the level design for each level, drawing it on paper and providing codex our ideas/drawings to get near the result we want. Then polish and adjust ourselves. A lot of playtesting to get the difficulty right, which can be tricky for a scaling game. 

A 4-12 player coop experience, where each level is a unique test of coordination, teamwork and friendship.

Some levels you will be a spaceship, some will have you in a rock band or crossing a heavily traffic road, chained together.

Hope you will give it a try! 

It's available to play local coop, online coop or a mix!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4958920/Squarelings\_Demo/
